title: $Γ$-Convergence of Weak-Type Nonlocal Functionals on Bounded Domains
summary: Let $N\ge1$, $p\in[1,\infty)$, $γ\in(0,\infty)$, and $Ω\subset\mathbb R^N$ be a bounded open interval when $N=1$ or a bounded Lipschitz domain when $N\ge2$.
